content:
The bad-row rate is consistent across all periods: ~94% before baseline, ~94% baseline-to-deploy, ~92% after deploy. The violation rate did not change at t=471, so the deploy is a decoy. Bad rows exist from t=1 onward, long before any deploy or watch period. No config VAT rate exists (E9). sync-job copies invoices faithfully (E8: ledger values identical to invoices values). The fault originates in data arriving into invoice-agent from outside — invoices are being submitted with VAT not equal to 15% of amount, a pre-existing bad_input condition.
